title: Agli service *main road wale garage* mein ho gayi.
fix_label: Due date se 5 din pehle ye bhejo 👇
message:
Hi [naam] 🚗 aapki [car model] ki service ko 6 mahine / [X] km hone wale hain.
Is hafte *[din] ya [din]* slot free hai. Pick-up chahiye to "PICKUP" reply karo.
why: car model + km = *personal lagta hai*. 2 din ka option aur pick-up se mana karna mushkil.
caption:
Service centre ka customer "bhool jaata hai", aur raaste ka garage use pakad leta hai. 🔧

Har service ke saath note karo: date + km. Phir due se 5 din pehle:
✅ Car model
✅ 2 din ke slot
✅ "PICKUP" option

Register se bhi ho sakta hai, automatic bhi. Save karo 🔖
